prompt.project_info: A warm, healing indoor lifestyle portrait with a candid Instagram aesthetic and cozy vintage color treatment.
prompt.main_subject: A young woman sitting casually indoors, with long dark hair parted in the center, soft natural makeup with a warm glow, and a gentle smile. She wears a pastel striped knit sweater in a relaxed, comfortable pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical close lifestyle portrait with the seated subject filling the lower frame. A creamy beige wall behind her is decorated with small taped photos and notes, rendered as soft unreadable background detail; retain the candid seated pose and shallow depth of field. Exclude readable text, logos, and watermarks.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm ambient indoor light creates soft shadows, natural skin texture, and an intimate cozy atmosphere. Apply film-style color grading with subdued warmth and a gentle vintage feel.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 2:3 portrait crop, eye-level close framing, shallow depth of field, soft focus falloff on the wall decorations, restrained film grain, realistic knit texture and natural skin detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cozy lifestyle portrait of a young woman sitting casually indoors, long dark hair parted in the center, soft natural makeup with a warm glow, gentle smile. Wearing a pastel striped knit sweater, relaxed and comfortable pose. Warm ambient indoor lighting, creamy beige wall background decorated with small taped photos and notes, shallow depth of field, soft shadows, film-style color grading, candid Instagram aesthetic, natural skin texture, cozy vintage vibe, high realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required for this template. If a replacement person, wardrobe, or room reference is attached, preserve the supplied identity as appropriate, the pastel striped knit sweater, relaxed seated pose, creamy wall, taped-photo-and-note arrangement as unreadable decor, and warm film-like indoor mood. Individual photos, notes, and room details are replaceable; do not reproduce readable text from a reference.
